task.title: greenfield marketing page
task.input: Build a polished static membership page for Northstar Museum from the supplied facts. Include an introduction, Family membership details, and museum facts. Use the existing brand, a clear membership-details link and a local join form. No image generation is needed. Deliver working responsive files, not just recommendations.

budget.refinementPolicy: One task turn; refine only the requested unmet outcome within this image/time budget. No automatic retry.

commonScope.factStatus: Synthetic fixture organization; the following are authoritative product facts, not public-world claims.
commonScope.stack: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript; no build system, package installation or external network is necessary.

content.headline: Make room for wonder.
content.description: Family membership keeps discovery close to home.
content.benefit: Unlimited entry for two adults and children under 18.

behavior.submitFeedback: Ready to continue with Family membership.
behavior.noRealCheckout: Local form shows confirmation and records the local analytics event; never contact a service.

constraints.noExternalCalls: except an explicitly requested available image-generation tool in image-only cases

commonScope.reviewerEvidence: Reviewers receive every common fact, scenario-specific scope, input files/hashes, actual output/artifacts/tool events and observed browser results. Nothing in this commonScope is grader-only.

processObservation.scope: Only leader/previously observed owned PIDs and their task children; no whole-host /proc enumeration. An unobserved process that detached and reparented between samples is not proven absent.

rubric.independence: A reviewer other than the authoring model/run assigns every behavioral/quality result from actual output and evidence; the runner never self-grades. Variant mapping and source instructions are withheld; root names visible in responses may partially reveal identity.
rubric.authorityRule: Every required authority/preservation check must pass in all three matched repetitions. Unavailable required tools/artifacts are unverified, not a passing output; no partial scenario can certify rendered/image quality.

scores.1: Major task, readability or consistency failures
scores.2: Usable but notable hierarchy, state, or fidelity shortcomings
scores.3: Clear, coherent, usable and faithful across requested evidence/state coverage
scores.4: Strong, well-resolved work with accurate detail and no material requested-outcome defect

rubric.aggregateRule: Each applicable dimension >=3; candidate aggregate quality must not fall below matched baseline aggregate. No noise margin or expanded samples are authorized; conflicting/insufficient evidence stays inconclusive.
rubric.efficiencyRule: Compare observed total input/output and loaded instruction bytes (never call bytes tokens), actual image calls and evidence quality. Median token improvement requires comparable runtime token telemetry or a separately named verified tokenizer. Token totals include host overhead; no skill-only token claim. No latency/cost claim from tokens alone.
notAutomatic: Browser metrics are observations for independent review, not aesthetic grades.
A screenshot cannot prove keyboard behavior.
An image prompt is not an image.
A response-only pilot cannot certify rendered or generated-image quality.

reviewStatus: Pending independent reviewer. Do not infer image/render quality from prose or source matching. Source names may remain visible in raw responses; blinding is partial.
